rag.text:
Test: TC-5046 — Box Module - Overview - Public REST API - Creating a Box via Public REST API
Priority: High | Status: To Do | Type: Manual
Folder: /

Steps:
1. Navigate to [https://developer.bigpicture.one/|https://developer.bigpicture.one/]
   Expected: Developer portal page loads.
2. Go to BigPicture API > Boxes > Create Box
   Expected: The page with Create Box endpoint loads.
3. Create a Box using the instructions provided on the Developer Portal page.
   Expected: The Box is created and is visible in the Box hierarchy.
